trait.name: Regeneration
entries: Ghoul-kin Bulwark regains 10 Hit Points at the start of its turn. If Ghoul-kin Bulwark takes fire damage, this trait doesn't function at the start of Ghoul-kin Bulwark's next turn. Ghoul-kin Bulwark dies only if it starts its turn with 0 Hit Points and doesn't regenerate.

trait.name: Keen Smell
entries: The Ghoul-kin Bulwark has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Ghoul-kin Bulwark makes three attacks: one with it's bite and two with it's claws, or three with it's acid spit.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h} {@damage 2d6+4} Slashing damage. If the target is not undead, it must succeed on a DC 10 Constitution saving throw or be paralyzed for 1 minute. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of it's turns, ending the effect on itself on a succes.

entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h} {@damage 1d6+4} Piercing damage.

action.name: Acid Spit
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 3} to hit, reach 45 ft., one target. {@h} {@damage 2d8} Acid damage.
